Title: Unfinished Business
Description: Settle Mortimer's three named debtors in their marked areas, then defeat the giant account called Compound Interest. Return to Mortimer when every account is closed.

Objectives.Text: Defeat Overdue Oliver in the western area.
Objectives.ProgressText: Overdue Oliver remains in the western collection area.

Objectives.Text: Defeat Delinquent Doris in the eastern area.
Objectives.ProgressText: Delinquent Doris remains in the eastern collection area.

Objectives.Text: Defeat Past-Due Percy in the northern area.
Objectives.ProgressText: Past-Due Percy remains in the northern collection area.

Objectives.Text: Defeat Compound Interest in the marked area.
Objectives.CompleteText: Compound Interest has been liquidated. Return to Mortimer.
